summary.headline: Siyaram Q2 FY27 total income rose 15.1% to Rs 827 crore, but PAT fell to Rs 75 crore from Rs 87 crore; revenue guidance raised to 14-15%.
summary.overview: Standalone total income grew 15.1% YoY to Rs 827 crore in Q2 FY27, and H1 total income rose 15.6% to Rs 1,293 crore. EBITDA rose to Rs 131 crore from Rs 121 crore, but PAT declined to Rs 75 crore from Rs 87 crore, with raw material inflation cited as the main margin drag. Management raised FY27 revenue growth guidance to 14-15% and kept the ~14% EBITDA guidance (before a 150 bps retail-driven drop). Retail (ZECODE and DEVO) scaled to 61 stores against a 70-store year-end target.

segments.name: Fabrics
segments.commentary: Contributed 77% of Q2 revenue. Volume up roughly 2.5% and value up roughly 11% YoY, per management's rough figures.

segments.name: Retail (ZECODE and DEVO)
segments.commentary: Combined H1 FY27 revenue about Rs 65 crore, mostly ZECODE; retail was about 3% of FY26 turnover. Store count 61 (38 ZECODE, 23 DEVO) vs 70 target; FY27 retail revenue guidance about Rs 160 crore. DEVO to reach about 22-25 stores; next-year expansion mainly ZECODE.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guidance raised to 14%-15%, citing H1 growth of about 14-15% and festive demand shifting into Q3.
EBITDA guidance of about 14% retained, excluding a 150 bps drop attributable to ZECODE and DEVO; management said it is too early to change guidance given uncertainty.
Retail (ZECODE and DEVO) targeted at about 70 stores by FY27 end, all internally funded; retail revenue target about Rs 160 crore for FY27.
FY27 capex guided at about Rs 100 crore; Rs 51 crore spent in H1 and management expects to be in line with the guidance.
Preference share listing expected in minimum about 6 months; applications filed with BSE and NSE.
Store expansion guidance for next year to be given at year end.
capex_capacity: H1 FY27 capex about Rs 51 crore against about Rs 100 crore full-year plan (of which Rs 46 crore for expansion as per analyst's citation).
Per retail store: about Rs 1-1.5 crore capex for furniture and security deposit, plus about Rs 70-80 lakh of inventory.
Retail stores: 38 ZECODE (about 19-20 in Bangalore, 10-12 rest of Karnataka, 3-4 Hyderabad, 2-3 Chennai) and 23 DEVO (North India: Delhi NCR, UP, Punjab, Rajasthan).
Many retail properties are built-to-suit and at different construction stages, which can delay openings.
Separate warehouse and IT system being set up for retail; lean, startup-style retail team.
demand_pricing: Industry demand described as broadly stable in H1 FY27 despite uneven monsoon and raw material inflation; rural/Tier-2/Tier-3 recovery noted over the past year.
Cumulative price hike of about 4%-6% taken over the last six months, implemented gradually; management avoids over-pricing given geopolitical uncertainty.
Festive demand: retail direct sales picking up; wholesale and channel demand lagging as dealer inventory clears.
Management said the fast fashion segment is growing more than twice the pace of the overall apparel industry; market is fragmented with no large branded share holder.
Management did not disclose volume/value split for retail or ZECODE-only revenue for Q2.

qa_highlights.question: Fabric volume and value growth in Q2?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said volume rose roughly 2.5% and value roughly 11%, while preferring absolute values over the volume-value split due to mix changes.

qa_highlights.question: Price hikes and gross margin decline?
qa_highlights.answer: Cumulative price hikes of about 4%-6% over six months; gross margin decline mainly from raw material inflation, with retail a smaller factor.

qa_highlights.question: Retail revenue and store expansion pace?
qa_highlights.answer: H1 retail revenue about Rs 65 crore (ZECODE + DEVO); FY27 target about Rs 160 crore; store count target 70 at FY27 end, with no 75-80 guidance given.

qa_highlights.question: Why was the revenue guidance raised?
qa_highlights.answer: H1 growth of about 14%-15%, festive season shifted into Q3 from October last year, and retail progress on track.

qa_highlights.question: Timeline for preference share listing?
qa_highlights.answer: Minimum about 6 months; no precedent, applications filed with BSE and NSE; interest payable from allotment date.

qa_highlights.question: Why is e-commerce not offered for ZECODE or DEVO?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said e-commerce is on the back burner to focus on the two brands and clusters; not ruled out for the future.

risks_watch: Raw material inflation and geopolitical uncertainty could pressure gross margin; price hikes are gradual, so pass-through lags.
Retail EBITDA drag capped at 150 bps; store profitability still early, and management did not quantify EBITDA-positive stores.
Q2 PAT fell about 14% YoY despite higher revenue, showing margin compression.
Festive season and dealer inventory clearance are key for achieving the 14%-15% revenue guidance in H2.
Funding and store plan for FY28 not yet defined; the retail model is still being proven at small scale.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the top line and festive-season upside, with the revenue guidance raised. Cautious on margins and raw material costs, where management declined to change EBITDA guidance. Evasive on store-level metrics and retail KPIs, which it said it would share only after the festive season, around year end.
key_quotes: We are confident that we shall be able to close the store count at 70 stores across the two formats by FY '27.
We have always had an EBITDA guidance of about 14% and we believe that it is too early to change that guidance because there is a lot of uncertainty.
Company is already generating enough cash flow. All the growth is happening through internal accruals.
There is no point in entering a business without profitability.

growth.why: FY27 revenue growth guidance raised to 14-15% on H1 growth of about 14-15% and festive demand shifting into Q3; backing is partial (price hikes of 4-6%, retail store rollout to 70 stores, Rs 100 crore capex) with no quantified volume or order commitments.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Q2 PAT fell to Rs 75 crore from Rs 87 crore (about -14% YoY) on raw material inflation, and EBITDA guidance of about 14% was held with a 150 bps retail drag excluded, so margin recovery is not guided.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Retail store count to rise from 61 to 70 by FY27 end (38 ZECODE, 23 DEVO), with about Rs 1-1.5 crore capex per store and many sites built-to-suit and still under construction, though openings can slip.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Fabric volume grew roughly 2.5% in Q2 and H1 total income rose 15.6%; revenue guidance raised to 14-15% for FY27 with festive demand shifting into Q3, but volume growth is modest and price-led (4-6% cumulative hikes).

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: FY27 capex held at about Rs 100 crore with Rs 51 crore spent in H1, and utilisation was not disclosed; no new major capacity plan was announced, with next-year store expansion guidance deferred to year end.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: FY27 revenue growth guidance was just raised to 14-15% on H1 growth of about 14-15% and festive demand shifting into Q3, though management said it is too early to change EBITDA guidance.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Raw material inflation and geopolitical uncertainty could pressure gross margin, with price hikes lagging, and the 14% EBITDA guide already excludes a 150 bps retail drag.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: No new product launch was discussed; retail brands ZECODE and DEVO are existing and e-commerce is on the back burner.

rows.label: Preference share listing on BSE/NSE
rows.why: Applications filed with BSE and NSE with a minimum timeline of about 6 months, though no precedent exists.

rows.label: Gradual pass-through of 4-6% cumulative price hikes
rows.why: Price hikes of 4-6% over six months are being implemented gradually, and management avoids over-pricing given geopolitical uncertainty, so pass-through to gross margin is uncertain.

rows.label: Festive season and dealer inventory clearance in H2
rows.why: Retail direct sales are picking up while wholesale and channel demand lag as dealer inventory clears, and H2 revenue guidance depends on festive demand.

tone.note: Management was confident on top-line growth and festive upside, and cautious on raw material costs and margins, declining to change EBITDA guidance; analysts pressed on Q2 margin compression and retail store-level economics, which management deferred to year end.
